 Refugio council extends deadline for town employees to use vacation time 
 Coy Slavik | cslavik@southtexasnews.com 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Updated

 REFUGIO – Refugio town employees will have until March 31 to use vacation time carried over from this year after the Town Council approved the extension on Tuesday, Nov. 17.
 Police Chief Hugo Rosas brought the request to the council because staffing shortages had made it difficult for police employees to take time off. Council members discussed extending the deadline until the department is fully staffed, but that motion died for lack of a second. The council then approved a fixed deadline that applies to all town employees.
 Hotel tax account stays frozen 
 A motion to unfreeze the town’s hotel occupancy tax account died for lack of a second. The account held about $13,400, according to figures discussed at the meeting.
 Council members discussed whether to give the Refugio County Fair Association part of the $8,500 it requested. Some pointed to the fair’s ability to draw visitors, while others said they wanted the account balance to grow before resuming awards. The council took no action on the fair association’s request.
 Council backs apartment renovation 
 The council approved a resolution supporting the proposed renovation of Refugio Apartments at 405 Osage Street. The resolution calls for waiving $250 in eligible town fees to show local support for a competitive housing tax credit application.
 City Attorney Thomas Gwosdz said the existing affordability requirements are set to expire. If the project receives the tax credits, those requirements could be extended.
 Holiday festival and property agreement 
 The council approved a request to use King Park for a holiday festival from 1 to 6 p.m. on Sunday, Dec. 13, along with related street closures. Organizers said they had canceled an earlier fall festival because of rain.
 The council deferred action on an encroachment agreement requested by Libertase Real Estate Group. Gwosdz said he planned to meet with the group to clarify what access it needs and how the request relates to a separate economic development project in the same area.
